I changed `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStorePart10.java` so the region overview lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within the same priority. It uses the same `ORDER BY CASE t.priority …` as the sales rep's open-ticket list. I also updated the method's Javadoc to match.

The code compiles. I didn't run any tests: no existing test calls `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion`, and I didn't add one. I haven't checked your T-1 to T-5 example against real data. The closed-ticket and other-region filters are unchanged.
